title: Definitions.
bodyText:
As used in this part:

"Fund" means the transit-oriented development infrastructure improvement program special fund established under section 206E-247.

"Program" means the transit-oriented development infrastructure improvement program developed by the authority pursuant to section 206E-246.
bodyHtml:
§206E-242  Definitions.  As used in this part:

     "Fund" means the transit-oriented development infrastructure improvement program special fund established under section 206E-247.

     "Program" means the transit-oriented development infrastructure improvement program developed by the authority pursuant to section 206E-246. [L 2022, c 184, pt of §1; am L 2025, c 252, §5]
